<documents>
<document id="security-new-device">
SigningˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdeviceˆWhenˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆphoneˆorˆcomputer,ˆweˆaddˆaˆshortˆsafetyˆperiod.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangesˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆtheˆfirstˆsign-inˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆandˆtransfersˆtoˆexternalˆaccountsˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500ˆinˆtotal.ˆCardˆpayments,ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆandˆdepositsˆaren'tˆaffected.ˆ##ˆWhyˆIfˆsomeoneˆstealsˆyourˆpassword,ˆtheˆfirstˆthingˆtheyˆusuallyˆtryˆisˆmovingˆmoneyˆoutˆquickly.ˆTheˆlimitˆgivesˆyouˆtimeˆtoˆnoticeˆtheˆsign-inˆalertˆandˆtellˆus.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆliftˆitˆearly?ˆNo.ˆTheˆlimitˆendsˆonˆitsˆown.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆremoveˆit.ˆ##ˆSign-inˆalertsˆWeˆsendˆanˆalertˆtoˆyourˆotherˆdevicesˆandˆyourˆemailˆwheneverˆaˆnewˆdeviceˆsignsˆin.ˆIfˆitˆwasn'tˆyou,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆmessageˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆ##ˆSwitchingˆphonesˆIfˆyouˆknowˆyou'llˆneedˆtoˆsendˆaˆlargeˆtransfer,ˆdoˆitˆfromˆyourˆoldˆphoneˆbeforeˆyouˆswitch,ˆorˆplanˆaroundˆtheˆwaitingˆperiod.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-delivery">
CardˆdeliveryˆtimesˆandˆtrackingˆWeˆmailˆphysicalˆcardsˆtoˆtheˆresidentialˆaddressˆonˆyourˆprofile.ˆCardsˆcan'tˆbeˆsentˆtoˆaˆPOˆboxˆorˆtoˆaˆdifferentˆaddressˆthanˆtheˆoneˆonˆfile.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆ-ˆStandardˆshipping:ˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdaysˆ-ˆExpeditedˆshipping:ˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆwithˆtrackingˆBusinessˆdaysˆdon'tˆincludeˆweekendsˆorˆbankˆholidays.ˆ##ˆTrackingˆExpeditedˆcardsˆcomeˆwithˆaˆtrackingˆlinkˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆCards.ˆStandardˆcardsˆdon'tˆhaveˆtracking,ˆbutˆtheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆdateˆweˆmailedˆit.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆdoesn'tˆarriveˆIfˆaˆstandardˆcardˆhasn'tˆarrivedˆ10ˆbusinessˆdaysˆafterˆweˆmailedˆit,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆcancelˆtheˆcardˆinˆtransitˆandˆsendˆaˆnewˆone.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆaˆcardˆthatˆgotˆlostˆinˆtheˆmail.ˆ##ˆMoving?ˆUpdateˆyourˆaddressˆbeforeˆorderingˆaˆcard.ˆAnˆaddressˆchangeˆmayˆneedˆproofˆofˆaddress.ˆSeeˆ"Updatingˆyourˆaddress".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-denied">
IfˆyourˆdisputeˆisˆdeniedˆSometimesˆaˆdisputeˆisˆdecidedˆagainstˆyou.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆthatˆmeans.ˆ##ˆWhyˆdisputesˆareˆdeniedˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆshowedˆyouˆmadeˆorˆauthorizedˆtheˆpurchase,ˆforˆexampleˆwithˆdeliveryˆproofˆsignedˆatˆyourˆaddress.ˆ-ˆTheˆdisputeˆwasˆfiledˆafterˆitsˆwindowˆclosed.ˆ-ˆTheˆmerchantˆalreadyˆrefundedˆyou.ˆ-ˆTheˆissueˆisn'tˆcovered,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆpriceˆyouˆagreedˆtoˆandˆlaterˆchangedˆyourˆmindˆabout.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆtoˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆWeˆsendˆyouˆaˆwrittenˆexplanationˆfirst.ˆ5ˆbusinessˆdaysˆlater,ˆweˆtakeˆtheˆprovisionalˆcreditˆback.ˆIfˆthatˆleavesˆyourˆbalanceˆnegative,ˆaddˆmoneyˆsoˆyourˆaccountˆisn'tˆrestricted.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆappeal?ˆYes,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆnewˆinformation.ˆReplyˆtoˆtheˆdecisionˆmessageˆwithˆtheˆnewˆdocumentsˆandˆwe'llˆreviewˆitˆagain.ˆWeˆcan'tˆreopenˆaˆdisputeˆjustˆbecauseˆyouˆdisagreeˆwithˆtheˆoutcome.ˆ##ˆNegativeˆbalanceˆSeeˆ"Negativeˆbalanceˆafterˆaˆdispute"ˆforˆhowˆrepaymentˆworks.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
